description: Java class representing a TorchScript value (IValue) with methods for type checking, creation, and conversion, used in PyTorch Android integration.

classes.name: IValue
classes.description: Represents a TorchScript value with various type-specific methods and factory methods for creation.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Checks if the IValue is null.

methods.name: isTensor
methods.description: Checks if the IValue is a tensor.

methods.name: isBool
methods.description: Checks if the IValue is a boolean.

methods.name: isLong
methods.description: Checks if the IValue is a long integer.

methods.name: isDouble
methods.description: Checks if the IValue is a double.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Checks if the IValue is a string.

methods.name: isTuple
methods.description: Checks if the IValue is a tuple.

methods.name: isBoolList
methods.description: Checks if the IValue is a list of booleans.

methods.name: isLongList
methods.description: Checks if the IValue is a list of longs.

methods.name: isDoubleList
methods.description: Checks if the IValue is a list of doubles.

methods.name: isTensorList
methods.description: Checks if the IValue is a list of tensors.

methods.name: isList
methods.description: Checks if the IValue is a list.

methods.name: isDictStringKey
methods.description: Checks if the IValue is a dictionary with string keys.

methods.name: isDictLongKey
methods.description: Checks if the IValue is a dictionary with long keys.

methods.name: optionalNull
methods.description: Creates an IValue representing a null optional.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Factory methods to create IValue instances from various types (Tensor, boolean, long, double, String, lists, tuples, dictionaries).

methods.name: toTensor
methods.description: Converts IValue to Tensor.

methods.name: toBool
methods.description: Converts IValue to boolean.

methods.name: toLong
methods.description: Converts IValue to long.

methods.name: toDouble
methods.description: Converts IValue to double.

methods.name: toStr
methods.description: Converts IValue to String.

methods.name: toBoolList
methods.description: Converts IValue to boolean array.

methods.name: toLongList
methods.description: Converts IValue to long array.

methods.name: toDoubleList
methods.description: Converts IValue to double array.

methods.name: toTensorList
methods.description: Converts IValue to Tensor array.

methods.name: toList
methods.description: Converts IValue to IValue array (list).

methods.name: toTuple
methods.description: Converts IValue to IValue array (tuple).

methods.name: toDictStringKey
methods.description: Converts IValue to Map with String keys.

methods.name: toDictLongKey
methods.description: Converts IValue to Map with Long keys.
